PhET Energy Skate Park vendored asset

GitHub source repository:
https://github.com/phetsims/energy-skate-park

Downloaded HTML asset:
https://phet.colorado.edu/sims/html/energy-skate-park/latest/energy-skate-park_en.html

Downloaded on: 2026-05-09
Embedded simulation version: 1.3.9
Language build: English

The HTML asset is vendored so this app can serve the simulation from a local
route instead of depending on a live external embed.

Local modifications:
- Hide the loading-screen PhET logo image.
- Hide the bottom-right PhET/settings/menu control cluster from the navigation bar.
